Native #Tests and #Meets-or-above remain unverified raw evidence. Accountability subset requires same district/campus on fall snapshot and testing date. policy.eligibility: Reconstruct exact operational same-year CCD attachments, complete native enrolled EE/PK/K/1–12 counts with positive grades 3–8 and zero grades 9–12, reconciled individual economic status and each original unmasked whole-percent R cell. Preserve all 78 grade-school profiles and their 78 original unmasked Math/ELA/paired Combined members. Reported tests/numerators, charter/type/reference labels and diagnostics never select membership.
policy.outcome: Only original published whole-percent CDA38AM0E225R / CDA38AR0E225R. Do not reconstruct masks, substitute count-ratio precision, reuse statewide or another district’s fits, or average grade percentages.
policy.combined: Equal mean of eligible original published Math and ELA whole-percent subject rates; not a count-derived ratio or the native fraction passing both. Never average grades or weight by enrollment.
policy.counts: Native reported #Tests and #Meets-or-above remain complete unverified raw evidence. Where all are available, their arithmetic can be reconciled with the original whole-percent display, but it does not certify valid-score denominators or select point-rate membership. Exact 2025 N/NAAR and M/medical performance-status mapping remains unresolved under the existing hold; no failed investigation is repeated. All valid-score counts, sampling variances and intervals remain null/unavailable, and the ten-valid-scored floor stays uncertified.
policy.models: Separate unweighted 2024–25 Cypress-Fairbanks grade-school Math, ELA and Combined district OLS. Combined independently fits its paired original-rate means with its own residual scale, deletions and external studentization. Equal cohorts can yield coefficient averages, never averaged studentized scores. No enrollment weights, clamping, fit-driven exclusions or national pooling.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use every explicit deleted-school fit and N−3 residual degrees of freedom, with independent centered full fits and held-out leverage. Cook distance and line sensitivity are descriptive, never exclusions.
policy.intervals: Every valid-score count, sampling variance and interval endpoint is null modelwide; the ten-valid-scored floor is uncertified. An internal zero variance vector is solely a computational sentinel, never an uncertainty estimate.
policy.compact_provenance: The complete committed immutable source retains all 1,107 original records / 42,828 typed cells and is the authoritative raw-record store. Exact whole-blob, source-code/tests/policy, raw-input/schema/definition fingerprints are required on every replay. Compact model inputs retain exact x/y/identities and original table row/field references; no loss of raw auditability is authorized.
policy.release: Numerical audit only, pending independent review and separate canonical/browser integration. All historical and numerical source/modeling approvals remain false; no high/mixed/primary/nonoperational population or count hold is released.
